content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently underestimate prices in early 2024, showing persistent downward bias.", "Sentiment spikes correlate with forecast overshoots, especially when sentiment is high and prices are falling.", "Model forecasts exhibit mean-reversion bias, often lagging true price movements by 3–5 days.", "High sentiment values (above 0.67) are associated with forecast overestimation, particularly in price declines.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with recent price trends, indicating sentiment interaction effects.", "Models fail to capture sharp reversals when sentiment shifts abruptly, leading to persistent lag in price correction.", "Forecasting models show diminishing accuracy as prices deviate significantly from historical mean, suggesting structural bias.", "Sentiment-driven volatility is not fully captured by models, leading to underestimation of price swings during sentiment extremes."]}
